profile:
COMPANY NAME: WidePoint Corporation
INDUSTRY: IT Services / Cybersecurity / Managed Services
PRODUCT OR SERVICE: WidePoint provides secure Identity & Access Management (IAM), Managed Mobility Solutions (MMS), and IT-as-a-Service (ITaaS) to protect mobile workforces and enterprise infrastructure. They also offer digital billing, analytics, and cloud security services.
TARGET CUSTOMERS: Government agencies (including those requiring top secret clearances) and commercial enterprises ranging from hundreds to thousands of users across North America.
PRICING MODEL: Enterprise / Customized
KEY FEATURES:
- Secure Identity & Access Management (IAM) with quantum-resistant PKI
- MobileAnchor™ multi-factor authentication
- Managed Mobility Solutions (MMS) for data protection and operational efficiency
- IT as a Service (ITaaS) and Cloud Security (MSP/MSSP/CSP)
- B2B & B2C billing and analytics solutions
UNIQUE SELLING POINTS: Quantum-resistant security solutions, top secret security clearances, and a history of merging specialized regional IT firms to offer customized, high-value solutions for both government and commercial sectors.
TONE & POSITIONING: Enterprise / Government / Security-Focused
